data.name: Sunjay
data.gender_notes: Sunjay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sunjay is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Surya' meaning Sun and 'Jaya' meaning Victory or Triumph. It signifies a person born under the auspicious rays of the Sun, bringing joy and happiness in life. The name Sunjay carries the meaning “Born of the Sun, Joyful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sunjay usually hope their child will grow to embody born of the sun, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sunjay is believed to invoke the blessings of the Sun God, symbolizing courage, strength, and illumination.
data.etymology: Sunjay belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Born of the Sun, Joyful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sunjay total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Sunjay was a king of the Suryavanshi dynasty mentioned in the Indian epic Mahabharata. He was the grandson of King Ikshvaku and the father of King Rama.
Sunjay was also a king of the ancient Indian kingdom of Kundinagar, mentioned in the Puranas. He is said to have ruled during the Treta Yuga and was a great devotee of Lord Vishnu.
